You can see the current status of any Subsidy Application you have access to on the Application record itself. Standard progression is Submitted → In Review → Assigned → Decision. If an application has sat in a single status for more than 10 business days, note it in the chat and an Assessor will follow up directly on the record. Please do not share clinical details here.
